premise: Nico starts a race across the bay; the fishing boat chugs ahead while the sailboat waits for wind, then the wind comes, and the fishing boat waits so they finish together.
inspiration: Aesop's tortoise and hare told with two boats: steady and swift both have their moment, and the one ahead slows down for its friend.

en-US.title: The Boat Race
en-US.text: {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to sand} Nico stood with his board, {surfer:face happy} looking out at the water. {sailboat:enter} Here came the sailboat. {fishing-boat:enter} And here came the fishing boat. {surfer:says} [excited] "A race! First one to the lighthouse side wins! Ready, steady… GO!" {fishing-boat:go to sea right} {sfx:chug} Chug, chug, chug! Off went the fishing boat, slow and steady. {sailboat:pulse} But the sailboat just sat there. No wind. Its sails hung down. {surfer:face sad} {surfer:says} [sad] "Come on, sailboat!" [short pause] {canvas:wind 0.8 20s} Then, WHOOSH, the wind came. {sailboat:live} The sails filled up, round and full, {sailboat:go to sea right} and the sailboat zoomed across the water! {surfer:face surprised} Chug, chug… whoosh, whoosh… side by side… {fishing-boat:live} The fishing boat hauled up its net, to slow down and wait for its friend. {surfer:hop x2} And they reached the far side… exactly together. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [laughs] "A tie! Both of you win!" {surfer:live} Nico waved his board in the air.

es-ES.title: La carrera de barcos
es-ES.text: {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to sand} Nico estaba con su tabla, {surfer:face happy} mirando el agua. {sailboat:enter} Por ahí llegaba el velero. {fishing-boat:enter} Y por ahí llegaba la barca de pesca. {surfer:says} [excited] «¡Una carrera! ¡Gana el primero que llegue al lado del faro! Preparados, listos… ¡YA!» {fishing-boat:go to sea right} {sfx:chug} ¡Chuc, chuc, chuc! Allá fue la barca de pesca, despacio pero sin parar. {sailboat:pulse} Pero el velero no se movía. Sin viento. Con las velas colgando. {surfer:face sad} {surfer:says} [sad] «¡Vamos, velero!» [short pause] {canvas:wind 0.8 20s} Y entonces, FIUUU, llegó el viento. {sailboat:live} Las velas se llenaron, redondas y gordas, {sailboat:go to sea right} ¡y el velero salió disparado por el agua! {surfer:face surprised} Chuc, chuc… fiu, fiu… uno al lado del otro… {fishing-boat:live} La barca subió su red, para ir más despacio y esperar a su amigo. {surfer:hop x2} Y llegaron al otro lado… exactamente a la vez. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [laughs] «¡Empate! ¡Ganáis los dos!» {surfer:live} Nico agitó su tabla en el aire.
